Column.ResizeHint: Drag to set the width; double-click for an automatic width
AddMenu.FolderTip: Tip: call FolderSwitch from File Explorer: “Current folder” then appears at the top of this menu and adds the open folder in one click.
AddMenu.UrlTip: Tip: call FolderSwitch from Firefox, Chrome or Edge: “Current URL” then appears at the top of this menu and offers the address of the page shown, to check before adding it.
Item.FoldersOnly: Only folders can be opened in this window.
Confirm.DeleteTab: Delete this tab and all the groups it contains?
Confirm.DeleteGroup: Delete this group and all the items it contains?
Error.TargetUnavailable: This location can't be reached. It may have been moved or deleted, or its drive is offline.
Error.ActionFailed: The action could not be completed.
Error.ColumnNotEmpty: Only an empty column can be deleted.
Error.LastTab: At least one tab must remain.
Settings.ConfigurationNote: Save your tabs, groups and settings to a file, to keep them or to use them on another PC. Before an import, the current configuration is backed up.
About.Description: Your favorite folders and files, opened instantly
UrlPrompt.Title: Add a website
UrlPrompt.Invalid: Enter a web address, for example morningstar.fr or https://www.morningstar.fr.
Hotkey.ApplyToTest: Apply this shortcut first, then try it here.
Hotkey.Issue.SingleModifier: A single modifier key is not enough: add another key.
Hotkey.Issue.NoModifier: Add at least one modifier key (Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win).
Hotkey.Issue.ReservedByWindows: This shortcut is reserved by Windows.
Hotkey.Issue.CtrlAltLikeAltGr: Ctrl + Alt is the same as AltGr on many European keyboards: this shortcut may get in the way when typing.
Hotkey.Issue.TakenByOtherApp: This shortcut is already used by another application.
Hotkey.Note.Recommended: Recommended shortcut. FolderSwitch reacts when Ctrl and ⊞ Win are released with no other key in between: the Windows shortcuts that start with Ctrl + ⊞ Win (virtual desktops, etc.) keep working.
Hotkey.Note.ModifiersOnly: Modifier keys only: FolderSwitch reacts when they are released, with no other key in between.
Wizard.Title: Welcome to FolderSwitch
Wizard.StartWithWindows.Hint: Recommended: FolderSwitch is then ready as soon as you sign in.
Wizard.StartWithWindows.Warning: If you uncheck this, you will have to start FolderSwitch yourself each time you sign in, otherwise the shortcut will do nothing.
Wizard.Language.Title: Choose your language
Wizard.Language.Intro: FolderSwitch has preselected the language of Windows.
Wizard.Language.Hint: English when the language of Windows is not available.
Wizard.Hotkey.Title: Your shortcut to open FolderSwitch
Wizard.Hotkey.Intro: It works everywhere: in File Explorer, in a “Save as” dialog box or anywhere else.
Wizard.Appearance.Intro: Choose a mode and a theme. The background color, the corners and the group colors can be set later.
Wizard.Startup.Intro: A few last settings before you start.
Wizard.Start.Sample.Hint: A “Windows” group with Desktop, Documents, Downloads and Pictures.
Wizard.Start.Empty.Hint: You add everything yourself in Edit mode.
Wizard.AutostartFailed: FolderSwitch could not set itself to start with Windows. You can try again later in the settings.
Setup.Updated: FolderSwitch has been updated to version {0}.
Update.Prompt: FolderSwitch {0} is available. Install it now? FolderSwitch will restart.
Update.CheckFailed: FolderSwitch could not check for updates. Please try again later.
Update.InstallFailed: The update could not be installed. Please try again later.
Config.RestoredFromBackup: Your configuration file was damaged: FolderSwitch restored its latest backup. The damaged file was kept in the same folder.
Config.ResetToDefault: Your configuration file was damaged and no backup could be used: FolderSwitch started with a new configuration. The damaged file was kept in the same folder.
Config.LoadFailed: FolderSwitch could not read its configuration file. It is running with a temporary configuration, and your changes will not be saved until it is restarted.
Config.SaveFailed: FolderSwitch could not save your changes.
Startup.HotkeyFailed: FolderSwitch could not register its shortcut. Open it from its icon in the notification area, then choose another shortcut in the settings.
